issue.title: Vault-sync conflict notification invokes the Pomodoro loop with missing arguments
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-46.3 note #1. src/native/vault_sync.rs::run_notify synchronously runs bob notify with no PRE_CHECK_SLEEP or POST_NOTIFY_SLEEP, discards both output streams, and accepts every Ok exit status. Native notify::parse_args requires exactly two timing arguments: bob pomodoro notify with none reproduced exit 2 during bob-cli-46 landing on 2026-10-04. The identical run_notify code exists in pre-epic fc438bc. Determine the intended one-shot vault-conflict notification contract and implement it with an observable failure path. Do not merely supply sleeps: notify::run_loop is an endless Pomodoro watcher, so a synchronous call would hang vault sync. Cover a resolved conflict, a missing notifier, and failed notification without mutating production vault state. The legacy bob notify spelling is intentionally retained for mixed installed binary versions.

task_type_fields.impact: Resolved Git conflicts never deliver the intended notification and the caller hides the usage error.
task_type_fields.repro: Run bob pomodoro notify with no args: exit 2, usage requires PRE_CHECK_SLEEP POST_NOTIFY_SLEEP. Inspect run_notify: invokes equivalent bob notify with no args, null stderr, ignores nonzero status; identical on fc438bc.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-46.3 note #1 proposed this pre-existing conflict-notification defect. Landing reproduced the usage exit and verified the same call existed on pre-epic fc438bc, so it is separate from the command-tree epic.

payload.description: Same resolve_conflicts path: run_notify fires on each conflict cycle, so this loop also re-triggers that notification bug every ~20s
